workflow.name: Google Calendar Interview Scheduler
workflow.description: Monitors a Google Sheet for new hiring prospects, calculates interview slots, creates Google Calendar events, generates personalized emails via GPT, and sends them via Gmail.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI (GPT-5.1) to generate interview emails

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name for email generation

GOOGLE_SHEET_ID.description: Google Sheet document ID (mocked in this project)

GOOGLE_SHEET_NAME.description: Sheet tab name in the Google Sheet (mocked)

GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID.description: Google Calendar ID for creating events (mocked)

GMAIL_SENDER_NAME.description: Sender name used in email signature

GMAIL_SENDER_COMPANY.description: Company name used in email signature

workflow_steps.name: Google Sheets Trigger
workflow_steps.description: Poll Google Sheets for new hiring prospect rows with candidate NAME, EMAIL, and EDUCATIONAL info

workflow_steps.name: Calculate Next Interview Slot
workflow_steps.description: Calculate the next available interview time slot (Mon/Wed/Fri at 3:00 PM, always in the future)

workflow_steps.name: Create Google Calendar Event
workflow_steps.description: Create a 1-hour Google Calendar event at the calculated interview slot

workflow_steps.name: Generate Interview Email
workflow_steps.description: Use GPT to generate a personalized interview invitation email with calendar link for each candidate

workflow_steps.name: Send Interview Email via Gmail
workflow_steps.description: Send the personalized interview invitation email to the candidate via Gmail
